envelope_coverage.algorithm: D04 19 anchors kept at A19 assumed heights. Other 215: 68% six-nearest D04 inverse squared distance interpolation + 32% A19 placeholder, clamped to 21.2–42.4m. Parapet on 19 D04 only, 0.55m proxy, not documented.
envelope_coverage.uncertainty: This improves visual continuity, not historical validation.

facade_articulation.geometry: One 0.32m wide horizontal facade ribbon on longest perimeter segment at 65% of proxy height, outward offset 0.13m
facade_articulation.provenance: ALL bands are inferred visualization placeholders; none are photo-verified. D04 heights based on assumed levels. A20 archived geometry preserved.
facade_articulation.note: Intentionally omit additional window and balcony details until camera calibration.

openings_coverage.opening_method: One rectangular actual mesh cutout on longest valid footprint boundary per plot, wall with eight triangles around hole; no framed window or glass.
openings_coverage.heights: A20 inferred heights retained; D04 19 not metrically verified
openings_coverage.historical_status: ALL apertures are PROVISIONAL and NOT photographically confirmed.
openings_coverage.orientation: Boundary edge from footprint; may face adjoining structures.
openings_coverage.limitations: No interior room, ventilation physics, or sealed compartments. NOT suitable for quantitative fire simulation.
